ss-delta 0.4.1 fixes the Windows setup for players whose Windows user name has a space in it: building the game stopped with "Windows SDK for Windows Store Apps Headers-x86_en-us.msi: msiexec failed (1639)" ([#9](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/9)). Nothing else changed: on Linux, macOS and Android it is the same as 0.4.0.

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `ss-delta-v0.4.1-windows.zip` | `ss-delta.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `ss-delta-v0.4.1-linux.tar.gz` | `ss-delta.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `ss-delta-v0.4.1-macos.tar.gz` | `Soul Sacrifice Delta.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `ss-delta-v0.4.1-android.apk` | **ss-delta** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. The first time, its importer asks for your own dump of Soul Sacrifice Delta (US PCSA00152 or EU PCSF00532, update 1.30), downloads the PS Vita firmware from Sony and a compiler, and builds the game on your computer in a few minutes. From then on the program goes straight to the game. Nothing of the game is in these downloads. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md).

macOS: the app isn't signed by a registered Apple developer, so macOS refuses it the first time. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway".

## Fixed

* **Windows: the setup stopped with "msiexec failed (1639)"** ([#9](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/9)) when the Windows temp folder's path has a space in it, which is the case when your Windows user name has one. The setup unpacks Microsoft's Windows SDK there for the compiler, and Windows Installer refused the way that folder was passed to it (and showed its list of command-line options). If you set `TEMP` and `TMP` to another folder to get around it, you can set them back.

## Upgrading from 0.4.0

If 0.4.0 already built the game for you, you don't need this release. Otherwise, unpack 0.4.1 over your game's folder (replace the files) and start it, or update through RecompLauncher, which then builds the game again from your dump. Coming from 0.3 or older, see [Updating](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#updating) and the [0.4.0 release](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/releases/tag/v0.4.0).

Every release's changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

SHA-256 and build attestations: see the files attached, and `gh attestation verify`.
